title: The article discusses the ongoing tensions between Mozambique and South Africa following the signing of the Nkomati Accord, which aimed to establish non-aggression and good neighborliness between the two nations. Despite the agreement, there are significant doubts regarding South Africa's compliance, as many in Mozambique believe that the South African Defence Force continues to support the Mozambique National Resistance (MNR) with training and supplies. This has led to increased MNR activity and attacks in and around Maputo, creating a climate of fear among residents. The article highlights the divided opinions within the South African military regarding their approach to Mozambique, with some factions wanting to maintain pressure on the Mozambican government while others seek its overthrow. Overall, the situation remains tense and complex, with ongoing concerns about the implications of South African military involvement in Mozambique.
